intro: The Bible describes growing closer to God with slow, living pictures: staying, being rooted, walking, bearing fruit. These passages give the main ones. The growth they describe is God’s work in a person, and it is not a technique.

passages.reason: Jesus pictures himself as a vine and his followers as branches: fruit comes from staying connected, “for apart from me you can do nothing”.
The first psalm compares a person who keeps returning to God’s teaching to “a tree planted by the streams of water”.
A direct call with a promise attached: “Draw near to God, and he will draw near to you”.
Paul describes the Christian life as continuing the way it began, “rooted and built up in him”, with thanksgiving.
Scripture is described as light for the next step: “Your word is a lamp to my feet, and a light for my path”.
